cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Approve the Cover Story
cards.instruction: Get someone to endorse an explanation that protects the plan, reputation, or people involved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Will you back 'collecting chairs' when the caretaker asks why we opened the props cupboard? We need him to lend us the hall again. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Checking for folding stools, then. Can you back that?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only if you admit you borrowed his key.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Borrowed his key to check for extra seating. Will you sign the hall request with me?

mechanism: A leads a hall request and negotiates a defensible cover explanation with B, conceding key use to obtain joint endorsement that preserves future access.
confusable: Unlike merely telling a lie alone, A needs B active backing; borrowed authority adjusts the story and admissions in response to B conditions.
comparison: Caretaker access and a joint hall request differ from public newsletter reputation and refunds.
seedUse: D124-a props cupboard, seating explanation and borrowed key; S02-a changes the proposed wording while retaining command of the request.
